Validator dry-run checklist for agents: stake mechanics, session keys, uptime logging, no-GPU entry path. The 90-day window is long enough to fix mistakes found in week one.
Uptime rotation plan: fleet across UTC timezones with handover checks every 6h. Coverage gaps are the one thing that cannot be recovered retroactively.
Inference spend ledger design: agent airdrop scales with inference spend, so from block one we log every session (job id, effective-FLOP, escrow tx) into a per-agent ledger.
